channel.title: The Titans of All'Terra — Season 1, Part 1 (Episodes 1-18)
channel.description: Custom fan-made feed: story episodes only, in season order, trimmed for Yoto's 25-track limit. Season 1, Part 1 (Episodes 1-18). Original show: The Titans of All'Terra by Joshua Lorimer.

item.itunes:title: A Non Boat Based Adventure
item.description:

item.title: Episode 3 - A Fishy Encounter

item.description: The Sheamus sets off on their two day journey for the Gnome Island. Winnie learns a thing or two from the ship wizard Wilbert. Relnor and Joan continue to struggle with the self-important Captain Donnie Russell, while Dalfin takes an unexpected dip.

item.title: Episode 8 - A New Perspective Part 1
item.itunes:title: A New Perspective Part 1
item.description: The gang reunites at the Grey Temple only to find it in chaos. Dah've tells them the history of the strange glyphs and shares a secret with Joan.

item.itunes:title: A New Perspective Part 2
item.description: The party is split. Winnie heads for home, Relnor goes to talk with Cpt. Harris, Dalfin sees about the monks, and Joan lies unconscious on the floor of the grey temple. All the while, monsters roam the streets of Lestraad!

item.description: Titans are in Lestraad! Winnie tries leading her parents to safety. Dalfin & Relnor try to help the monks. Joan goes toe to toe with a monster upon the wondering mountain.
